blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—The UAAP Season 89 Final Four race just took an interesting turn after Sunday night’s doubleheader at Smart Araneta Coliseum. Far Eastern University and defending champion La Salle bolstered their Final Four bids on Sunday with big wins over the top two teams in the league, National University and University of the Philippines, respectively. That put the Tamaraws and the Green Archers in a tie for third with similar 8-5 slates, while the Bulldogs and Fighting Maroons continued to share the top at 9-4.
